question: Does C203 or the surrounding 196-199 architecture explain local survival of the accepted 7B neutral netarsudil/SAM family?
mutation_coordinate_method: Reciprocal donor side-chain coordinates transplanted in the target residue's N-CA-C local frame; target backbone unchanged; local side chains subsequently flexible.

refinement.sam: explicit and rigid at canonical coordinates
refinement.flexible_region: same established local neighborhood, including every side-chain-bearing residue 196-208

acceptance_gate.replicate_pass_rule: PASS if at least 2 of 3 attempts pass every gate; FAIL if 0 of 3; otherwise INDETERMINATE

causal_rules.C203_supported: C203N converts 7B WT PASS to FAIL or produces reproducible material migration/contact loss/strain above gate, and N203C produces a reciprocal improvement in the fair 7A transfer.
causal_rules.surrounding_supported: The reciprocal 196-199 block weakens 7B more than C203N alone under separate metrics.
causal_rules.distributed_supported: Neither single C203 exchange is sufficient, while the 196-199 block or combined probe reproducibly alters several independent structural dimensions.
causal_rules.indeterminate: Mutation outcomes are non-reciprocal, preparation-limited, or do not discriminate the hypotheses.

interpretation_boundary: Structural compatibility only; no affinity, activation, allostery, catalysis, biochemical selectivity, or RNA inference.
